"""
Teams domain model.

A **team** is a hybrid group of AI profiles and human users that share a
common purpose inside a project. Typical examples:

- ``Engineering`` — coding profiles + engineers
- ``Support``     — support-facing profiles + support agents
- ``Leadership``  — planning profiles + team leads

Teams are **per project** (exactly like chats) and are persisted as JSON files
by :class:`codx.junior.teams.team_manager.TeamManager`.

Example persisted team:

```json
{
  "id": "6f1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-abcd-ef0123456789",
  "project_id": "proj_123",
  "name": "Engineering",
  "description": "Builds and reviews the product",
  "color": "#6366f1",
  "icon": "fa-solid fa-robot",
  "profiles": ["software_developer", "analyst"],
  "users": ["alice", "bob"],
  "tags": ["engineering"],
  "created_by": "admin",
  "updated_by": "admin",
  "created_at": "2025-01-01T10:00:00",
  "updated_at": "2025-01-01T10:00:00"
}
```
"""

from datetime import datetime
from typing import List, Optional

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


def _now_iso() -> str:
    """Return the current local time as an ISO-8601 string."""
    return datetime.now().isoformat()


class Team(BaseModel):
    """
    A hybrid team of AI profiles and human users within a project.

    Attributes:
        id: Unique team identifier (UUID). Assigned server-side on create.
        project_id: Project this team belongs to (set server-side).
        name: Human-readable team name, e.g. ``"Engineering"``.
        description: Purpose / responsibilities of the team.
        color: UI accent colour (hex string).
        icon: UI icon (FontAwesome class or URL).
        profiles: AI profile names that are part of the team.
        users: Human usernames that are part of the team.
        tags: Free-form tags used to categorize/filter teams.
        created_by: Username that created the team.
        updated_by: Username that last updated the team.
        created_at: Creation timestamp (ISO-8601).
        updated_at: Last update timestamp (ISO-8601).
    """

    id: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="Unique team identifier (UUID)")
    project_id: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None, description="Project this team belongs to"
    )
    name: str = Field(default="", description="Human-readable team name")
    description: str = Field(
        default="", description="Purpose / responsibility of the team"
    )
    color: str = Field(default="#6366f1", description="UI accent colour (hex)")
    icon: str = Field(default="", description="UI icon (FontAwesome class or URL)")
    profiles: List[str] = Field(
        default_factory=list, description="AI profile names that are part of the team"
    )
    users: List[str] = Field(
        default_factory=list, description="Human usernames that are part of the team"
    )
    tags: List[str] = Field(
        default_factory=list, description="Free-form tags to categorize the team"
    )
    created_by: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None, description="Username that created the team"
    )
    updated_by: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None, description="Username that last updated the team"
    )
    created_at: str = Field(
        default_factory=_now_iso, description="Creation timestamp (ISO-8601)"
    )
    updated_at: str = Field(
        default_factory=_now_iso, description="Last update timestamp (ISO-8601)"
    )

    Payload for adding/removing team members.

"""
TeamManager — project-scoped team persistence.

Teams are hybrid groups of AI profiles and human users that share a common
purpose within a project (e.g. "Engineering", "Support", "Leadership").
They are stored as JSON files inside the project's ``.codx`` directory:

    <codx_path>/teams/<slugified-name>.<team-id>.json

Storing teams next to the project (like chats under ``tasks/``) keeps them
scoped to the project they belong to.

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class TeamManager {
        +settings: CODXJuniorSettings
        +teams_path: str
        +list_teams() List~Team~
        +find_by_id(team_id) Optional~Team~
        +find_by_name(name) Optional~Team~
        +save_team(team) Team
        +delete_team(team_id) bool
        +add_members(team_id, profiles, users, actor) Team
        +remove_members(team_id, profiles, users, actor) Team
    }
```
"""

import os
import json
import uuid
import logging
import pathlib

from datetime import datetime
from typing import List, Optional

from slugify import slugify

from codx.junior.settings import CODXJuniorSettings
from codx.junior.teams.model import Team

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

TEAMS_DIR = "teams"
TEAM_FILE_EXTENSION = ".json"


def _dedupe(values: List[str]) -> List[str]:
    """Return *values* with duplicates removed, preserving order."""
    return list(dict.fromkeys(values))


class TeamManager:
    """
    Manages hybrid teams (AI profiles + humans) for a given project.

    Contract:
        * ``save_team`` upserts by ``id`` (a new id is generated when missing)
          and removes the superseded file when the name changes.
        * ``add_members`` / ``remove_members`` mutate the persisted team and
          return the saved instance.

    :param settings: Project-level settings.
    """

    def __init__(self, settings: CODXJuniorSettings) -> None:
        """Initialise the manager, creating the ``teams`` directory."""
        self.settings = settings
        self.teams_path = os.path.join(settings.codx_path, TEAMS_DIR)
        os.makedirs(self.teams_path, exist_ok=True)
        logger.debug("TeamManager initialized at '%s'", self.teams_path)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Path helpers
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _team_file_path(self, team: Team) -> str:
        """
        Build the canonical file path for *team*.

        :param team: Team whose path to compute.
        :return: Absolute file path string.
        """
        return os.path.join(
            self.teams_path,
            f"{slugify(team.name)}.{team.id}{TEAM_FILE_EXTENSION}",
        )

    def _team_file_paths(self) -> List[str]:
        """Return every team file path for this project."""
        return [
            str(path)
            for path in pathlib.Path(self.teams_path).glob(f"*{TEAM_FILE_EXTENSION}")
            if path.is_file()
        ]

    def _find_team_file(self, team_id: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
        """
        Return the file path backing *team_id*, or ``None`` when missing.

        The team id is the last segment of the file name
        (``<slug>.<id>.json``), so matching on the suffix is unambiguous.

        :param team_id: Team UUID to locate.
        :return: File path or ``None``.
        """
        if not team_id:
            return None
        suffix = f".{team_id}{TEAM_FILE_EXTENSION}"
        return next((p for p in self._team_file_paths() if p.endswith(suffix)), None)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Loading
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _load_team_from_file(self, file_path: str) -> Optional[Team]:
        """
        Load and deserialize a single team from a JSON file.

        :param file_path: Absolute path to the team JSON file.
        :return: A :class:`Team` instance, or ``None`` if loading fails.
        """
        try:
            with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                data = json.loads(fh.read())
            return Team(**data)
        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
            logger.error("Failed to load team from '%s': %s", file_path, exc)
            return None

    def list_teams(self) -> List[Team]:
        """
        Return all teams saved for this project, sorted by name.

        :return: List of :class:`Team` instances.
        """
        teams = [
            team
            for team in (self._load_team_from_file(p) for p in self._team_file_paths())
            if team is not None
        ]
        teams.sort(key=lambda team: (team.name or "").lower())
        logger.info(
            "Listed %d teams for project '%s'", len(teams), self.settings.project_id
        )
        return teams

    def find_by_id(self, team_id: Optional[str]) -> Optional[Team]:
        """
        Return a single team by id, or ``None`` when not found.

        :param team_id: UUID of the team to locate.
        :return: Loaded :class:`Team` or ``None``.
        """
        file_path = self._find_team_file(team_id)
        if file_path:
            return self._load_team_from_file(file_path)
        if team_id:
            logger.warning("Team id '%s' not found", team_id)
        return None

    def find_by_name(self, name: Optional[str]) -> Optional[Team]:
        """
        Return a single team by (case-insensitive) name, or ``None``.

        :param name: Team name to look up.
        :return: Loaded :class:`Team` or ``None``.
        """
        if not name:
            return None
        target = name.strip().lower()
        return next(
            (
                team
                for team in self.list_teams()
                if (team.name or "").strip().lower() == target
            ),
            None,
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # CRUD
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def save_team(self, team: Team) -> Team:
        """
        Create or update a team (keyed by ``id``) and persist it to disk.

        A new UUID is assigned when the team has none, and the team is always
        bound to the current project. When the team was renamed, the previous
        file is removed so no orphan is left behind.

        :param team: The team to persist (mutated in place).
        :return: The persisted team.
        :raises ValueError: when the team has no name.
        """
        if not team.name or not team.name.strip():
            raise ValueError("Cannot save a team without a name.")

        if not team.id:
            team.id = str(uuid.uuid4())

        # Teams always belong to the current project.
        team.project_id = self.settings.project_id

        now = datetime.now().isoformat()
        team.updated_at = now
        if not team.created_at:
            team.created_at = now

        # Detect a pre-existing file (id is stable) so a rename removes the
        # superseded file instead of leaving an orphan behind.
        previous_file = self._find_team_file(team.id)
        file_path = self._team_file_path(team)

        with open(file_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            fh.write(json.dumps(team.model_dump(), indent=2))

        if previous_file and previous_file != file_path and os.path.isfile(previous_file):
            os.remove(previous_file)
            logger.info("Removed superseded team file '%s' after rename", previous_file)

        logger.info("Saved team '%s' (id=%s) to '%s'", team.name, team.id, file_path)
        return team

    def delete_team(self, team_id: Optional[str]) -> bool:
        """
        Delete the team identified by *team_id*.

        :param team_id: UUID of the team to delete.
        :return: ``True`` when a team was deleted, ``False`` otherwise.
        """
        file_path = self._find_team_file(team_id)
        if file_path and os.path.isfile(file_path):
            os.remove(file_path)
            logger.info("Deleted team '%s' at '%s'", team_id, file_path)
            return True
        logger.warning("Attempted to delete non-existent team '%s'", team_id)
        return False

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Membership
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def add_members(
        self,
        team_id: str,
        profiles: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        users: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        actor: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> Team:
        """
        Add AI profiles and/or humans to a team (duplicates are ignored).

        :param team_id: UUID of the team to update.
        :param profiles: AI profile names to add.
        :param users: Human usernames to add.
        :param actor: Optional username recorded in ``updated_by``.
        :return: The persisted team.
        :raises ValueError: when the team does not exist.
        """
        team = self.find_by_id(team_id)
        if not team:
            raise ValueError(f"Team not found: {team_id}")

        if profiles:
            team.profiles = _dedupe(list(team.profiles or []) + list(profiles))
        if users:
            team.users = _dedupe(list(team.users or []) + list(users))
        if actor:
            team.updated_by = actor

        return self.save_team(team)

    def remove_members(
        self,
        team_id: str,
        profiles: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        users: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        actor: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> Team:
        """
        Remove AI profiles and/or humans from a team.

        :param team_id: UUID of the team to update.
        :param profiles: AI profile names to remove.
        :param users: Human usernames to remove.
        :param actor: Optional username recorded in ``updated_by``.
        :return: The persisted team.
        :raises ValueError: when the team does not exist.
        """
        team = self.find_by_id(team_id)
        if not team:
            raise ValueError(f"Team not found: {team_id}")

        if profiles:
            remove_profiles = set(profiles)
            team.profiles = [p for p in (team.profiles or []) if p not in remove_profiles]
        if users:
            remove_users = set(users)
            team.users = [u for u in (team.users or []) if u not in remove_users]
        if actor:
            team.updated_by = actor

        return self.save_team(team)

"""
Teams API router.

Provides CRUD endpoints for hybrid teams (AI profiles + human users) scoped to
the active project. Teams are persisted **per project** (exactly like chats)
and are managed by :class:`codx.junior.teams.team_manager.TeamManager`.

The active session is read from ``request.state.codx_junior_session`` (the same
convention used by ``codx/junior/api/chat.py``).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    LIST[GET /api/teams] --> LM[TeamManager.list_teams]
    READ[GET /api/teams/{team_id}] --> FM[TeamManager.find_by_id]
    CREATE[POST /api/teams] --> SV[TeamManager.save_team]
    UPDATE[PUT /api/teams/{team_id}] --> SV
    DELETE[DELETE /api/teams/{team_id}] --> DL[TeamManager.delete_team]
    ADDM[POST /api/teams/{team_id}/members] --> AM[TeamManager.add_members]
    REMV[DELETE /api/teams/{team_id}/members] --> RM[TeamManager.remove_members]
```
"""

import logging
from typing import List, Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request, status

from codx.junior.engine import CODXJuniorSession
from codx.junior.model.model import CodxUser
from codx.junior.security.user_management import get_authenticated_user
from codx.junior.teams.model import Team, TeamMembers
from codx.junior.teams.team_manager import TeamManager

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

router = APIRouter()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _get_session(request: Request) -> CODXJuniorSession:
    """Return the session bound to the current request."""
    session = getattr(request.state, "codx_junior_session", None)
    if session is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
            detail="Project session not available for this request.",
        )
    return session


def _get_team_manager(session: CODXJuniorSession) -> TeamManager:
    """Instantiate a :class:`TeamManager` from the active session's settings."""
    return TeamManager(settings=session.settings)


def _actor(user: Optional[CodxUser]) -> Optional[str]:
    """Return the acting user's username, or ``None``."""
    return user.username if user and getattr(user, "username", None) else None


def _split_csv(value: Optional[str]) -> List[str]:
    """Split a comma-separated query parameter into a clean list."""
    if not value:
        return []
    return [item.strip() for item in value.split(",") if item.strip()]


async def _read_members(request: Request) -> TeamMembers:
    """
    Resolve team members from a JSON body and/or query parameters.

    A JSON body (``{"profiles": [...], "users": [...]}``) is preferred; any
    ``profiles``/``users`` query parameters are merged in so clients that
    cannot send a body on DELETE still work.

    :param request: The incoming request.
    :return: A populated :class:`TeamMembers` object.
    """
    profiles: List[str] = []
    users: List[str] = []

    try:
        body = await request.json()
    except ValueError:
        body = None

    if isinstance(body, dict):
        profiles.extend(body.get("profiles") or [])
        users.extend(body.get("users") or [])

    profiles.extend(_split_csv(request.query_params.get("profiles")))
    users.extend(_split_csv(request.query_params.get("users")))

    return TeamMembers(profiles=profiles, users=users)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Endpoints
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@router.get("/teams", response_model=List[Team])
def list_teams(
    request: Request,
    user: CodxUser = Depends(get_authenticated_user),
) -> List[Team]:
    """Return all teams for the active project."""
    session = _get_session(request)
    teams = _get_team_manager(session).list_teams()
    logger.info(
        "User '%s' listed %d teams for project '%s'",
        _actor(user) or "anonymous",
        len(teams),
        session.settings.project_id,
    )
    return teams


@router.post("/teams", response_model=Team)
async def create_team(
    request: Request,
    user: CodxUser = Depends(get_authenticated_user),
) -> Team:
    """
    Create a new team for the active project.

    The request body is a JSON object matching the :class:`Team` schema
    (``name`` is required; ``description``, ``color``, ``icon``, ``profiles``,
    ``users`` and ``tags`` are optional). A fresh id is always assigned by the
    server.

    Example body:

    ```json
    {
      "name": "Engineering",
      "description": "Builds and reviews the product",
      "color": "#6366f1",
      "icon": "fa-solid fa-robot"
    }
    ```
    """
    session = _get_session(request)
    body = await request.json()
    try:
        team = Team(**(body or {}))
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        logger.warning("Invalid team payload from user '%s': %s", _actor(user), exc)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc

    if not team.name or not team.name.strip():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Field 'name' must not be empty.")

    # Always allocate a fresh id for a new team and stamp ownership.
    team.id = None
    team.created_by = _actor(user)
    team.updated_by = _actor(user)

    saved_team = _get_team_manager(session).save_team(team)

    logger.info(
        "User '%s' created team '%s' (id=%s) in project '%s'",
        _actor(user) or "anonymous",
        saved_team.name,
        saved_team.id,
        session.settings.project_id,
    )
    return saved_team


@router.get("/teams/{team_id}", response_model=Team)
def get_team(
    team_id: str,
    request: Request,
    user: CodxUser = Depends(get_authenticated_user),
) -> Team:
    """
    Return a single team by id.

    :raises HTTPException 404: when no team with the given id exists.
    """
    session = _get_session(request)
    team = _get_team_manager(session).find_by_id(team_id)
    if not team:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Team '{team_id}' not found.")
    return team


@router.put("/teams/{team_id}", response_model=Team)
async def update_team(
    team_id: str,
    request: Request,
    user: CodxUser = Depends(get_authenticated_user),
) -> Team:
    """
    Update an existing team (partial update applied over the stored team).

    Fields present in the body are applied on top of the stored team, so
    omitted fields keep their previous value. ``id``, ``project_id`` and
    ``created_at`` cannot be changed by the client.

    :raises HTTPException 404: when no team with the given id exists.
    :raises HTTPException 422: when the resulting name is empty.
    """
    session = _get_session(request)
    manager = _get_team_manager(session)
    existing = manager.find_by_id(team_id)
    if not existing:

// Team View – shared metadata & client-side grouping helpers
//

// ── Business roles ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Maps the profile `category` to a friendly label, an icon, a hint and a
// DaisyUI badge class. Class names are full literals so Tailwind detects them.
export const ROLE_META = {
  project: {

    hint: 'Leads and coordinates the team',
    icon: 'fa-solid fa-crown',
    badge: 'badge-primary'

    icon: 'fa-regular fa-file-code',
    badge: 'badge-warning'
  }
}

export function roleMeta(category) {
  return ROLE_META[category] || ROLE_META.assistant
}

// ── Departments (fallback grouping) ──────────────────────────────────────────
export const DEFAULT_TEAMS = [
  { id: 'leadership', name: 'Leadership', color: '#6366f1', icon: 'fa-solid fa-crown', profiles: [] },
  { id: 'product', name: 'Product & Design', color: '#22d3ee', icon: 'fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles', profiles: [] },

  allowed_tools: [],

  risk_threshold: 10.0,
  use_llm_classifier: false
}

// ── API <-> local team mapping ───────────────────────────────────────────────
// The backend `Team` model (codx/junior/teams/model.py) matches the local team
// object closely, so the mapping is a thin normalisation.

/** Build a local UI team from an API team. */
export function toLocalTeam(apiTeam) {
  return {
    id: apiTeam.id,
    name: apiTeam.name || 'Team',
    description: apiTeam.description || '',
    color: apiTeam.color || '#6366f1',
    icon: apiTeam.icon || 'fa-solid fa-people-group',
    profiles: apiTeam.profiles || []
  }
}

/** Serialise a local UI team into the payload accepted by the teams API. */
export function toApiTeam(team) {
  return {
    id: team.id,
    name: team.name,
    description: team.description || '',
    color: team.color || '#6366f1',
    icon: team.icon || '',
    profiles: team.profiles || []
  }
}

// ── Local assignment fallback ────────────────────────────────────────────────
const STORAGE_PREFIX = 'codx-team-view-assignments'

function storageKey(projectId) {
  return `${STORAGE_PREFIX}:${projectId || 'default'}`
}

export function loadAssignments(projectId) {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storageKey(projectId)) || '{}') || {}
  } catch {
    return {}
  }
}

export function saveAssignments(projectId, assignments) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(storageKey(projectId), JSON.stringify(assignments || {}))
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[team-view] Failed to persist team assignments', e)
  }
}

// Initial department guess for a member that has no explicit assignment yet.
export function defaultTeamId(member) {
  switch (member?.category) {
    case 'project':
      return 'leadership'
    case 'chat':
      return 'support'
    case 'file':
      return 'product'
    default:
      return 'engineering'
  }
}

// ── Presentation helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Same robohash/gravatar fallback used by ProfileCard / EditProfile.

  if (member?.avatar) return member.avatar
  const seed = encodeURIComponent(member?.name || 'member')
  return `https://gravatar.com/avatar/baa8db8ab2afb7ababc235269e762662?s=200&d=robohash&r=${seed}`
}

export default {
  name: 'TeamView',
  // `params` is supplied by dockview when the app runs as a desktop panel.

        const matchSearch = !q ||

        const matchTeam = !this.teamFilter || this.memberTeamId(member) === this.teamFilter

            if (team.id === saved.id) return toLocalTeam(saved)
            if (previous && team.id === previous.id) {

        this.$ui.addNotification({ text: `Changes to “${profile.name}” saved`, type: 'success' })
      } catch (e) {

      } finally {

      this.saving = true

          category: payload.category,
          avatar: '',
          description: payload.description || '',
          content: payload.content || '',
          llm_model: '',
          file_match: '',
          profiles: [],
          tools: [],
          api_settings: { active: false, modelName: '', modelDescription: '' },
          guardrails: { ...EMPTY_GUARDRAILS },

      this.search = ''
